strengths: The code is well-structured and follows a consistent naming convention.
The use of TypeScript interfaces and props typing is excellent and helps with code maintainability.
The code is free of console.log statements and other debugging code, which is great for a production-ready application.
improvements: Some of the variable names could be more descriptive. For example, 'items' in the TaskList component could be renamed to 'tasks' to make it clearer what it represents.
The TaskCard component could benefit from some basic styling to make it more visually appealing. Currently, it's just a plain article element with some text inside.
The TaskList component has a lot of props that are not being used. It would be better to remove these unused props to declutter the code and make it easier to understand.
aiReview.overall: Overall, the code is well-structured and follows good coding practices. However, there are some minor improvements that could be made to make the code even more maintainable and visually appealing.
